Therefore the evidence-producing capsule can retain different MAX_PASSES/_record_batch_progress semantics from the live producer and backlog-first Forge consumer unless the completion policy is installed or moved into the core itself.

go_tracks.track_a: ADVANCED: prevented path-dependent premature historical saturation from being mistaken for an executable terminal backfill PASS.
go_tracks.track_b: ADVANCED: strengthened a reusable single-authority causal/evidence invariant by requiring completion semantics to be path invariant across all historical-ingestion mutation callers.

hypothesis: Path-invariant completion semantics are necessary for a terminal historical-backfill receipt to support downstream Distillery/J-Space dataset promotion without transport-dependent false saturation.
counterhypothesis: Only the long-lived scheduler/Forge paths matter; the standalone capsule cannot affect saturation evidence.
counterhypothesis_disposition: REJECTED_AT_SOURCE_INTEGRATION_LEVEL: the capsule repeatedly calls ingest_artifact_history and is the exact carrier that emits FREE_SWARM_HISTORICAL_BACKFILL_RECEIPT/v1.
